title: Kyaiktiyo Pagoda

identities.name: Kyaiktiyo Pagoda
identities.address: Mount Kyaiktiyo, Kyaikhto Township, Mon State, Myanmar

mapIdentity.scope: The OSM node for Golden Rock and nearby mapped trail, two public-domain site photographs, and the nearby hotel environmental survey documenting the specific shrine dimensions.

note: A rough, leaf-gilded 7.6 m granite boulder balances on a dark outcrop. Its tapered 7.3 m stupa ends in an open-sided umbrella. A narrow guarded bridge and stone steps connect to the east and lower approach.
